indicesNarrative: The tape is a clean risk-off rotation: mega-cap growth and semis led the downside (QQQ -2.67%, MGK -2.63%, SMH -5.11%), while the Dow, equal-weight S&P and small caps fell roughly half as much and defensives (XLU +0.18%, XLP +0.27%) finished green. That dispersion — RS 100 grade-A on RSP/XLF/XLU/XLP versus RS 10-20 on XLK/QQQ — says money is rotating out of AI/tech leadership rather than de-risking wholesale. Breadth at 43% above the 200SMA with only 25.3% near 52-week highs confirms a market that has lost its momentum base, not one in freefall.
